name: antideploy
description: Deploy and run apps on Antideploy from your coding agent. Sign in with one link; no dashboard, Dockerfile or key to copy.
long_description: Ask your agent to deploy a project and it shows you one link; you open it and click Approve. It then creates the application and a Postgres database if the project needs one, deploys, reads the logs, and tells you where the app is live and on which account. It works from a local folder, so no GitHub repository is needed. It never shows a token or password to the agent, never uploads a .env file, only acts inside the folder it was started in, and does not delete anything.
